items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: Stuff and I -- he joined Trent's Treb's band in Lexington, Kentucky in 1927

ctx.x: Stuff Smith. He was born in Portsmouth, Ohio. Stuff and I -- he joined Trent's Treb's band in Lexington, Kentucky in 1927, the fall of 1927. Stuff Smith joined our band then. And after he played, you know, on the bandstand with us, Alphonso Trent Treb took Stuff and put him out front, and then direct the band and played the fiddle. And he was a genius. A great musician, a great ear. And, oh, man, he was just tops.

And Stuff and myself, we -- at times we used to room together, you know. And we would get our -- he would get his fiddle out and I'd get my horn out, and we -- all we thought of was, you know, playing music. We just played practically all day. We just played all day, you know. And we enjoyed it, see. Great guy.
